property_summary: For any sequence of receive calls, the invariant (depositsCount <= address(c).balance) holds because each receive increments depositsCount by 1 and adds at least 1 wei; the mutant increments depositsCount by 2, so after at least one receive with an odd wei amount, the invariant is violated.
change_summary: Replace `depositsCount++` with `depositsCount += 2` so the counter increments by 2 instead of 1, changing the observable state after receive().
